# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language reference, providing comprehensive word definitions, vocabulary tools, and educational games for learners of all ages.

Merriam-Webster offers multiple dictionary products including the free online dictionary with 300,000+ definitions, the comprehensive Unabridged dictionary with 700,000+ entries, and the Collegiate Dictionary. The site features daily vocabulary learning through Word of the Day, word game tools like Word Finder for Scrabble, specialized resources for slang and student learning, and mobile apps across iOS and Android platforms.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and word lookup
- Word of the Day vocabulary learning
- Scrabble and word game solving
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- Unabridged Dictionary (700,000+ entries)
- Slang and contemporary language
- Student and kids dictionaries
- Vocabulary building and SAT/ACT prep
- Latin and Greek word roots
- Word games (Quordle, Blossom, Quizzitive)
- Mobile apps (iOS, Android)
- Letter patterns and word unscrambling
- Language reference tools
- Etymology and word origins

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage with 300,000+ word definitions and integrated word games
- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/): Comprehensive online dictionary with 700,000+ definitions (subscription)
- [About the Unabridged | Merriam-Webster Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/info/about-the-unabridged.html): Features and capabilities of the Unabridged dictionary product
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Product page for Collegiate Dictionary Twelfth Edition reference book

## Vocabulary Learning & Daily Features

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary learning feature with podcast, email & social media options
- [The Merriam-Webster Vocabulary Builder](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/products/the-merriam-webster-vocabulary-builder): Vocabulary book for SAT/ACT/TOEFL prep with Greek & Latin roots

## Word Games & Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble helper tool for finding words by letter patterns and combinations
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile app downloads for dictionary, Scrabble & word game applications

## Specialized Dictionaries

- [Slang Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Definitions for trending slang, Gen Z phrases, and internet terminology
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Age-appropriate dictionary and educational games for young learners

## Optional

- [Merch – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/merch): Language-themed merchandise including tote bags and accessories
